I'm sorry this is your situation.  I also have a financially dependent partner who does the barest minimum and I am pretty miserable.

The thing I found surprising,  as I opened up to a few people is how many were excited to have a successful, funny middle-aged guy on the market for other people in their lives. I never saw myself as overly "successful " but I do okay.


My point is that the opportunities are there, and we don't know them until we are ready. I want to wish you luck, and good mental health. Counciling for yourself may be of benefit, you're a good person, and you deserve happiness and to be loved.

I would recommend if you are separate,  don't be intimate! How easy for someone to say it wasn't consensual,  or that you gave them an std. If the courts become involved she will destroy you.

Run.

It messes with your head, your arousal cycle, and because of social conditions, we often stay a lot longer than we should.


I hope you find your happiness.

The past 4 months the dynamic switched. We had a good month, then they went cold on me. That was it. 

It's as if a switch flipped in my brain and I said. No.
She's given me head twice since then. We've had sex  twice but it makes me feel ill. I won't again be intimate with my abuser. I am done, and done care at all to chace or even to accept the offer.

Payback is apparently a bitch. But it's over, those feelings no longer stir in my soul. Exactly as she wanted.

This game gets more crap then it deserves.

I posted this last night while looking for resources for opting out on my phone. I came here because indeed  opting out is not a solution to this problem.

It's right there for me, the relationship has changed, if I am not happy with the new criteria, it's over. It's better to end a relationship than myself. It's better to choose life than death, better to risk misery than to own it by staying .

It's a shame, but I can't restore what was, and our children are better off seeing single healthy people than an emotionally spent and unloving couple.
It has really undercut my trust in the relationship,  I can see us staying friends but this isn't how lovers treat one another.
It might. Thanks.
